# Elite Force

> Elite Force is a UK-wide private security and debt recovery firm serving high net worth individuals, families, family offices and businesses. Tagline: Protection. Collection. Results.

Website: https://eliteforce.site

## Protection services
- Close protection for individuals and families
- Residential and estate security
- Event and venue security
- Travel and journey management
- Threat and risk assessment

## Collection services
- High-value debt recovery
- Commercial debt collection
- Private loan recovery
- Asset tracing and investigation
- Enforcement support alongside solicitors and enforcement officers

## Coverage
England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, including London, Manchester, Cheshire, Liverpool, Birmingham, Leeds, Newcastle, Bristol, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Aberdeen, Cardiff, Swansea and Belfast.

## How to engage
Message or call +44 7348 131285 (WhatsApp enabled) to speak to a director, email enquiries@eliteforce.site, or use the enquiry form at https://eliteforce.site/#enquire. Every engagement is director-led and confidential.
